arguments.description: Catalogo centrale AUTSYS: progetti, sorgenti dati, componenti, release, artefatti/firme, capacita esterne e sincronizzazione iniziale dei registri schema.
arguments.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_project_registry (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    project_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name text NOT NULL,
    entity_kind text NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    root_path text,
    repository_url text,
    repository_branch text,
    description text,
    parent_project_public_id uuid,
    is_authoritative boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_project_data_sources (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    project_public_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.autsys_project_registry(public_id),
    data_source_key text NOT NULL,
    source_type text NOT NULL,
    locator text,
    database_name text,
    schema_name text,
    access_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read',
    connection_via text,
    is_authoritative boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    lifecycle_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (project_public_id, data_source_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_project_components (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    project_public_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.autsys_project_registry(public_id),
    component_key text NOT NULL,
    display_name text NOT NULL,
    component_type text NOT NULL,
    current_version text,
    local_path text,
    repository_url text,
    repository_branch text,
    lifecycle_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (project_public_id, component_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_release_registry (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    project_public_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.autsys_project_registry(public_id),
    component_key text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    version text NOT NULL,
    release_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'known',
    released_at timestamp without time zone,
    changelog_summary text,
    signing_summary text,
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (project_public_id, component_key, version)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_release_changes (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    release_public_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.autsys_release_registry(public_id),
    ordinal_int integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    change_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'change',
    summary_text text NOT NULL,
    details_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (release_public_id, ordinal_int)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_release_artifacts (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    release_public_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.autsys_release_registry(public_id),
    artifact_name text NOT NULL,
    artifact_type text,
    artifact_path_or_uri text,
    sha256 text,
    size_bytes bigint,
    signature_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DA_VERIFICARE',
    signature_notes text,
    signature_verified_at timestamp without time zone,
    signer_thumbprint text,
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (release_public_id, artifact_name)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.autsys_external_capabilities_registry (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE,
    provider_key text NOT NULL,
    capability_key text NOT NULL,
    capability_type text NOT NULL,
    capability_description text NOT NULL,
    capability_level text,
    access_mode text NOT NULL,
    scope_text text,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    requires_approval boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    risk_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'green',
    policy_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    constraints_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    verification_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'declared',
    last_verified_at timestamp without time zone,
    metadata_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (provider_key, capability_key)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.autsys_capabilities_unified AS
SELECT
    'ROBERTA_PLUGIN'::text AS source_kind,
    capability_public_id::text AS source_public_id,
    plugin_key::text AS provider_key,
    capability_key::text AS capability_key,
    capability_type::text AS capability_type,
    capability_description::text AS capability_description,
    capability_level::text AS capability_level,
    NULL::text AS access_mode,
    is_enabled::boolean AS is_enabled,
    requires_approval::boolean AS requires_approval,
    risk_level::text AS risk_level,
    policy_json::jsonb AS policy_json,
    metadata_json::jsonb AS metadata_json
FROM public.plugin_capabilities_server
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'EXTERNAL'::text,
    public_id::text,
    provider_key,
    capability_key,
    capability_type,
    capability_description,
    capability_level,
    access_mode,
    is_enabled,
    requires_approval,
    risk_level,
    policy_json,
    metadata_json
FROM public.autsys_external_capabilities_registry;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.schema_registry_reconciliation_live AS
SELECT
    'table'::text AS object_kind,
    t.table_schema::text AS schema_name,
    t.table_name::text AS table_name,
    NULL::text AS column_name,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
        WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
          AND r.schema_name=t.table_schema
          AND r.table_name=t.table_name
          AND r.is_active=true
    ) THEN 'registered' ELSE 'missing' END::text AS registry_status
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_schema='public' AND t.table_type='BASE TABLE'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'column'::text,
    c.table_schema::text,
    c.table_name::text,
    c.column_name::text,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.schema_columns_registry r
        WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
          AND r.schema_name=c.table_schema
          AND r.table_name=c.table_name
          AND r.column_name=c.column_name
          AND r.is_active=true
    ) THEN 'registered' ELSE 'missing' END::text
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN information_schema.tables t
  ON t.table_schema=c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name=c.table_name
 AND t.table_type='BASE TABLE'
WHERE c.table_schema='public';

INSERT INTO public.schema_tables_registry
(scope,engine,schema_name,table_name,logical_table_key,table_family,purpose_text,data_domain,ownership_scope,storage_scope,lifecycle_status,is_active,is_shared_capable,created_by_migration,metadata_json)
SELECT
    'server',
    'postgresql',
    t.table_schema,
    t.table_name,
    t.table_name,
    CASE
      WHEN t.table_name LIKE 'schema_%' THEN 'schema'
      WHEN t.table_name LIKE 'plugin_%' THEN 'plugin'
      WHEN t.table_name LIKE 'system_%' THEN 'system'
      WHEN t.table_name LIKE 'autsys_%' THEN 'autsys'
      WHEN t.table_name LIKE 'user_%' OR t.table_name IN ('users','organizations') THEN 'user_knowledge'
      ELSE 'operational'
    END,
    'Tabella PostgreSQL reale sincronizzata nel registro schema da AUTSYS PC BRIDGE.',
    'AUTSYS',
    'server',
    'central',
    'active',
    true,
    false,
    '20260916_AUTSYS_CENTRAL_CATALOG_V1',
    jsonb_build_object('registry_sync','information_schema','synchronized_at',now())
FROM information_schema.tables t
WHERE t.table_schema='public'
  AND t.table_type='BASE TABLE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
      WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
        AND r.schema_name=t.table_schema
        AND r.table_name=t.table_name
        AND r.is_active=true
  );

INSERT INTO public.schema_columns_registry
(table_public_id,scope,engine,schema_name,table_name,column_name,logical_column_key,data_type,is_nullable,default_value_text,purpose_text,allowed_values_json,source_hint,retrieval_use,visibility_scope,plugin_read_policy_json,plugin_write_policy_json,relation_hint,lifecycle_status,is_active,created_by_migration,metadata_json)
SELECT
    tr.public_id::text,
    'server',
    'postgresql',
    c.table_schema,
    c.table_name,
    c.column_name,
    c.table_name || '.' || c.column_name,
    c.data_type,
    (c.is_nullable='YES'),
    c.column_default,
    'Colonna PostgreSQL reale sincronizzata nel registro schema da AUTSYS PC BRIDGE.',
    '[]'::jsonb,
    'information_schema.columns',
    'schema_introspection',
    'internal',
    '{}'::jsonb,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    NULL,
    'active',
    true,
    '20260916_AUTSYS_CENTRAL_CATALOG_V1',
    jsonb_build_object('ordinal_position',c.ordinal_position,'udt_name',c.udt_name)
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN information_schema.tables t
  ON t.table_schema=c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name=c.table_name
 AND t.table_type='BASE TABLE'
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.public_id
    FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
    WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
      AND r.schema_name=c.table_schema
      AND r.table_name=c.table_name
      AND r.is_active=true
    ORDER BY r.id
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON true
WHERE c.table_schema='public'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_columns_registry r
      WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
        AND r.schema_name=c.table_schema
        AND r.table_name=c.table_name
        AND r.column_name=c.column_name
        AND r.is_active=true
  );

INSERT INTO public.schema_table_knowledge_registry

SELECT

    v.semantic_summary,
    v.contains_entities_json,
    v.operational_use_text,
    v.openai_selection_hint,
    v.key_columns_json,
    v.relation_hints_json,
    v.openai_card_text,
    tr.public_id::text,
    'active',true,50,true,true,true,

       'Usare quando serve sapere quali progetti o prodotti AUTSYS esistono e dove sono referenziati.',
       '["project_key","display_name","entity_kind","lifecycle_status","root_path","repository_url"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_project_data_sources.project_public_id","autsys_project_components.project_public_id","autsys_release_registry.project_public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS PROJECT REGISTRY: catalogo centrale dei progetti/prodotti e dei loro riferimenti.'),
      ('autsys_project_data_sources',
       'Sorgenti dati associate ai progetti AUTSYS, incluse basi dati, API e filesystem, senza credenziali.',

       'Risoluzione delle sorgenti dati autoritative e del metodo di accesso consentito.',
       'Usare insieme ad autsys_project_registry quando occorre raggiungere i dati di un progetto.',
       '["project_public_id","data_source_key","source_type","locator","database_name","access_mode","is_authoritative"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_project_registry.public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS DATA SOURCES: mappa progetto-sorgente dati e autorita della sorgente.'),
      ('autsys_project_components',
       'Componenti tecnici che compongono un progetto AUTSYS e relative versioni o posizioni correnti.',
       '["component","service","client","server","gateway"]'::jsonb,
       'Inventario dei componenti reali di ciascun progetto.',
       'Usare per capire architettura e componenti correnti di un progetto AUTSYS.',
       '["project_public_id","component_key","component_type","current_version","local_path","repository_url"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_project_registry.public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS COMPONENTS: componenti tecnici e riferimenti correnti per progetto.'),
      ('autsys_release_registry',
       'Cronologia delle release AUTSYS per progetto e componente.',
       '["release","version"]'::jsonb,
       'Tracciamento versioni, stato release, data, changelog sintetico e stato firma aggregato.',
       'Usare per ricostruire quale versione e nota per un prodotto o componente.',
       '["project_public_id","component_key","version","release_status","released_at","signing_summary"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_project_registry.public_id","autsys_release_changes.release_public_id","autsys_release_artifacts.release_public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS RELEASES: cronologia versioni per progetto e componente.'),
      ('autsys_release_changes',

       '["release change","changelog item"]'::jsonb,

       'Usare quando serve il dettaglio di cosa e cambiato in una release.',
       '["release_public_id","ordinal_int","change_kind","summary_text"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_release_registry.public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS RELEASE CHANGES: voci di changelog ordinate per release.'),
      ('autsys_release_artifacts',
       'Artefatti concreti di una release AUTSYS con hash e stato di firma verificabile.',
       '["artifact","EXE","MSI","APK","ZIP","signature"]'::jsonb,
       'Tracciamento file di release, integrita e firma a livello di singolo artefatto.',
       'Usare per verificare esistenza, hash e stato firma di un file di release.',
       '["release_public_id","artifact_name","artifact_type","artifact_path_or_uri","sha256","signature_status","signature_verified_at"]'::jsonb,
       '["autsys_release_registry.public_id"]'::jsonb,
       'AUTSYS RELEASE ARTIFACTS: file di release, hash e firma per artefatto.'),
      ('autsys_external_capabilities_registry',
       'Capacita fisiche esterne disponibili all assistente e ai bridge AUTSYS, separate dalle capacita plugin interne ROBERTA.',
       '["capability","PC Bridge","connector","tool"]'::jsonb,
       'Bootstrap delle capacita realmente disponibili, dei limiti e delle policy di accesso.',

) AS v(table_name,semantic_summary,contains_entities_json,operational_use_text,openai_selection_hint,key_columns_json,relation_hints_json,openai_card_text)
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.public_id
    FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
    WHERE r.engine='postgresql' AND r.schema_name='public' AND r.table_name=v.table_name AND r.is_active=true
    ORDER BY r.id
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON true
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.schema_table_knowledge_registry k
    WHERE k.engine='postgresql'
      AND k.schema_name='public'
      AND k.table_name=v.table_name
      AND k.is_active=true
);
